question: Who was recognised as ‘Asthana Nartaki’ (resident dancer) of the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam for her contribution in the development and promotion of the Indian classical dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yamini Krishnamurthy.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yamini Krishnamurthy**

 
 
• ​**Yamini Krishnamurthy** was recognised as ‘**Asthana Nartaki’** (resident dancer) of the **Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam** for her contribution in the development and promotion of the **Indian classical dance forms.**
 
• Mungara Yamini Krishnamurthy, an Indian dancer who specialises in **Kuchipudi and Bharatanatyam, was born on December 20, 1940.**
 
• In Madras, Yamini Krishnamurthy made his **debut in 1957.**
 
• She holds the **honour of being the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam's Asthana Nartaki (resident dancer). **
 
• The **Padma Shree (1968), Padma Bhushan (2001), and Padma Vibhushan (2016)**, three of the highest civilian honours bestowed by the Republic of India, were among the many honours she received for her dancing career.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• At **Chennai's Kalakshetra Academy of Dance, **Yamini Krishnamurthy studied Bharatnatyam under **Rukmini Devi Arundale.**
 
• Afterwards, she received training from illustrious teachers like **Thanjavur Kittappa Pillai and Kanchipuram Ellappa Pillai.**
 
• Under the instruction of **Vedantam Lakshmi Narayana Shastri, Chinta Krishnamurthy, and Pasumarthy Venugopal Krishna Sharma,** she learned Kuchipudi.
 
• Yamini studied Odissi under **Guru Pankaj Charan Das and Kelucharan Mahapatra** in addition to Bharatnatyam and Kuchipudi.
